title: Natural coefficient-universe comparison for positive-degree etale cohomology
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact separated scheme and F a quasi-coherent module. Set E=F_et [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] and let L be sectionwise ULift to coefficient universe u+1. For q=n+1 with n>=0 there exists an additive equivalence H^q(X_et,L(E)) -> H^q(X_et,E), with the small-coefficient group computed using HasExt.standard, commuting with every abelian sheaf endomorphism theta:E->E. The same equivalence works for all theta, and no preservation of injectives by ULift is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03P2, separated-case finite affine open cover argument, naturality on one fixed cover.

proof.text: Choose R = injectiveResolution E. Construct S by mapping R and its augmentation through the additive coefficient-lift functor L. Its terms are injective by etale_ulift_injective, and its augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism because etale_ulift_preservesHomology. The singleMapHomologicalComplex comparison supplies the source of the augmentation. This is a real construction, not a choice of an arbitrary witness.

Evaluate R and S at the terminal etale object T = Etale.mk (identity X). Apply the general natural resolution-evaluation comparison in each coefficient universe, explicitly using HasExt.standard for the small-coefficient cohomology. The evaluation complex of S is definitionally the coefficient lift of that of R. Compose the two additive equivalences with ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso for AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor and AddEquiv.ulift to obtain e before introducing theta.

Lift theta to phi = InjectiveResolution.desc theta R R, with augmentation equation desc_commutes_zero. Mapping that equation through L shows that L(phi) lifts L(theta) on the constructed S. The two natural resolution-evaluation equations and ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality show that e intertwines theta. Apply eS.injective and lower the equality of lifted elements. No affine cover is needed and all original hypotheses are retained.

proof_origin.place: Natural injective-resolution computation and coefficient-lift injectivity; shorter route using existing etale_ulift_injective and etale_ulift_preservesHomology interfaces.

from.place: Proper-case proof: identify H^1(C,G_a) with H^1(C,O_C) compatibly with endomorphisms, before interpreting Frobenius-minus-identity on the finite-dimensional vector space. This node supplies the positive-degree coefficient-universe part of that comparison.

theorem exists_etaleTensorSectionsSheaf_cohomology_ulift_natural_succ
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [X.IsSeparated]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ) :
    let E := etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F
    let L := sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}
    ∃ e : Sheaf.H (L.obj E) (n + 1) ≃+
        @Sheaf.H _ _ X.smallEtaleTopology E inferInstance (HasExt.standard _) (n + 1),
      ∀ (θ : E ⟶ E) (x : Sheaf.H (L.obj E) (n + 1)),
        e (Sheaf.H.map (L.map θ) (n + 1) x) =
          @Sheaf.H.map.{u + 1, u, u, u + 1} _ _ X.smallEtaleTopology
            inferInstance (HasExt.standard _)
            _ _ θ (n + 1) (e x)
